purpose: This form is used to give public notice of the proposed conversion of an unlimited liability company into a limited liability company by shares or guarantee.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Within seven days from the date of passing of the special resolution in a general meeting
steps: Pass a special resolution in a general meeting for the conversion of the unlimited liability company.
Publish a notice in Form No. INC-27A in two newspapers and on the company website within seven days of passing the special resolution.
Dispatch a copy of the notice to creditors and debenture holders by registered post, speed post, or courier with proof of dispatch.
checklist: Special resolution passed in a general meeting
Notice prepared in Form No. INC-27A
Two newspapers selected for publication, one in English and one in vernacular language
List of creditors and debenture holders prepared as on the date of notice of the general meeting
watch: Not stated in the Rules text
